event_summary: A small pale rectangular block moves around on the top of a black circular object while nearby objects remain visibly stationary.
raw_event_description: The scene shows a wooden tabletop with a black circular object on the right, a small pale rectangular block on its top, a black cord extending from the circular object, and a tilted metallic object with a purple hanging strip on the left. Over time, the pale block changes position and orientation across the black circular top: it begins near the front-right/front-center area, shifts toward the left side, passes near the left and upper-left portions of the top, and ends closer to the upper-right area. The black circular object, cord, metallic object, purple strip, table, and background remain in the same visible positions.

reasons: The main objects are fully visible on the tabletop.
The pale block is already visible on the black circular top at the beginning.
No scene cut or camera repositioning is visible.
